mapper.insert: insert into trading.demand_response ( id, demand_id, responder_id, responder_name, product_id, version_id, connector_id, proposal, quoted_price, pricing_model, delivery_type, status, reject_reason, created_at, updated_at ) values ( #{id}, #{demandId}, #{responderId}, #{responderName}, #{productId}, #{versionId}, #{connectorId}, #{proposal}, #{quotedPrice}, #{pricingModel}, #{deliveryType}, #{status}, #{rejectReason}, #{createdAt}, #{updatedAt} )
mapper.select: select * from trading.demand_response where demand_id = #{demandId} order by created_at desc
